guards: TaskGuard.disclosure_recheck calls authorize_run_route_disclosure, which requires active_candidate; errors invalidate disclosure and cancel the run.
Every private event/output disclosure uses fresh TaskAuthorization before_disclosure.
Initial/resumed runs have one-second periodic accelerators, not authority leases.
Fresh model/tool effect rechecks reject stale route/current credential.
